==Description==
'''Paradoxum Project 2''' is a group owned by BelowNatural. It was originally used for multiple other games [[Paradoxum Games]] worked on in 2020, though none of them have seen the light of day. The group is now mostly abandoned as the only member is BelowNatural himself.

There are four known games made under this group. While some were never publicly announced, they were briefly mentioned by Beefchoplets in the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server.
#First game is a [https://www.roblox.com/games/4895809537/Roblox-Dungeons dungeon crawler]. This was the only teased game.
#Second game is [https://www.roblox.com/games/5945696092/Zombie-Defense Zombie Defense], which was most likely the second tower defense game that would function similarly to the ''Tower Heroes'' freeplace mode.
#Third game is [https://www.roblox.com/games/5710879332/SkyBlox SkyBlox], which was a skyblock fighting game.
#Fourth and last game is [https://www.roblox.com/games/4971957140/Woodfields Woodfields], which was most likely the remake of ''The Underground War'' by Stickmasterluke.

==Trivia==
*The dungeon crawler made until this group actually has had some information shared about it and a few teasers made for it.
**A dungeon crawler where players fight against stone creatures.
***Other than some basic features, like an inventory, tools, attacks or enchantments, not much is known about the project.
